name: ProdScribe AI – Product Descriptions for WooCommerce
author: shubhamgate

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/prodscribe-ai-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure the AI API settings (if applicable).

Changelog

1.0.0
– Initial release
sections.description:
A WordPress plugin that leverages AI to generate compelling product descriptions for WooCommerce products.

Third-Party Services

This plugin relies on the following third-party AI services to generate content:
– OpenAI API: Used for generating high-quality product descriptions. Privacy Policy | Terms of Service
– OpenRouter API: Provides access to various AI models for description generation. Privacy Policy | Terms of Service

[!NOTE]
You will need an API key from either OpenAI or OpenRouter to use this plugin. Data such as product names, attributes, and images may be sent to these services to generate descriptions.

Features

  • AI-powered description generation.
  • Integration with WooCommerce product editor.
  • Custom prompts based on product attributes.
